purpose: Compare identical current algorithms across the legacy and profile-stratified identity splits. This is not an old-model/new-model accuracy comparison.

policy.labelUse: Labels are read only after split assignment and scoring; no model or split seed search.

calibration.method: Separate development identities, baseline windows only; descriptive calibration, not a medical false-positive rate.

ablation.comparison: Same cohort, split, dates, thresholds, NLP and rules; only the anomaly contribution is disabled.

clinicalPerformance.reason: Synthetic positive scenarios are partial; unlabelled days are not confirmed negatives.

limitations: All records and scenarios are synthetic, with no independent clinical outcomes.
A representative profile mix does not establish representative clinical outcomes or calibrated precision.
Different split strategies evaluate different seniors/cases; their coverage cannot be read as a performance gain.
The fixed representative split has only two authored scenarios; repeated generator seeds preserve those case identities and are not independent cases.
Daily observations are correlated. Unlabelled flags measure workload and cannot establish false alarms.

historicalComparison.meaning: The earlier v2 snapshot and current legacy-modulo run retain the same cohort, identity roles and numeric thresholds. New language rules change cue features and refit/calibrate the forest. An average delay among detected cases is not directly comparable when the detected-case set changes.
